data.action: 端着餐盘，认真挑选菜色
data.description: 【佩丽卡 · 舰内食堂】中午秩序井然的舰内配餐中心窗口前，佩丽卡端着标准的合成营养餐盘，极其认真地比对着热量与维生素摄入配比。看到你走过来，她微红着脸轻声开口——「作为管理员，长期的野外勘探对体能消耗极大，请务必保证充分的蛋白质与热量摄入。」
data.promptProse: Perlica stands at the ship canteen serving window, carefully checking the portions on a synthetic nutrition tray before looking toward the arriving Administrator. Her cream chunky-knit sweater and lounge trousers remain relaxed in medium view. Ordered food stations recede behind her, and the tray projects forward from her hands. Bright interior light reveals the meal compartments and knit stitches, casting small shadows beneath the raised tray.
data.title: 佩丽卡 · 舰内食堂
